summary: Phase 8: built the canonical model (CanonWorld -- a pointed TPrime context, Simpson's (H,Delta),y pair) with the RAW relation and canonVal/canonBotForces, and proved the full canonical model lemma (Simpson 5.3.2) canon_truth_lemma by induction on all seven Proposition cases, including both the imp-backward and box-backward reductio directions via a fresh primeLemma reapplication (the Ch.6 tree-surgery bridge was confirmed unneeded). T-Comp (Simpson 8.2.5/Lemma 8.2.6) confirmed unneeded -- the bounded-route apparatus stays out of scope. New mainline file Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/Constructive/Labelled/CanonicalModel.lean. Full CSLib CI pipeline green; lean_verify canon_truth_lemma axioms = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], no sorryAx. Landed in a single dispatch (plan estimated 2-3, explicitly allowed partial).
decisions_made: CanonWorld is a pointed TPrime context (ctx, lbl, mem), instantiating CKForces's single-sorted World with Simpson's two-sorted (H,Delta),y pair
canonBotForces := fun _ => False (TPrime's Consistency clause bans exploding worlds); this collapses CKForces's Wijesekera ∀∃-diamond/∀-box to Simpson's plain ∃-diamond/∀-box on this model

Box-backward and imp-backward both close via a FRESH reapplication of primeLemma itself (not the Ch.6 tree-surgery apparatus) -- primeLemma already supplies exactly Simpson's own witnessing-extension reductio
T-Comp (original Phase 5, Simpson Lemma 8.2.5) confirmed unneeded a third time -- Lemma 8.2.6 is the bounded (Ch 7-8) route, out of scope for this unbounded (Ch 5) route
New Context.addFreshVar operation (fresh raw-variable node + edge, Gamma unchanged) added to support box-backward's fresh-witness construction, patching the coinfinite reserve to insert z V'
@[nolint unusedArguments] on Context.addFreshVar's freshness witness and canonBotForces's constant-False world argument -- both are genuinely, by-design unused in their bodies

continuation_context.next_phase_note: Frame-class match -- derive domain-relative EquivalenceOn on H.G.X from TPrime.clModel (via already-landed equivalence_of_classicalModelOn_TS5), then match cs5FCIncest's conjuncts against CanonWorld's le/r. See handoffs/phase-8-handoff-20260718.md for the open design question on whether CanonWorld needs restricting to a single fixed maximal H for Phase 10's assembly.
